remarks: Welcome home to Woodland Road. Offering over 4000 sf, a two-story foyer, four bedrooms, three-and-a-half bathrooms, and a finished basement. The updated kitchen and entertaining space opens to a family room overlooking the renovated inground, heated pool. Recently installed Mahogany front door, rear door and sliders out to the pool. Countless updates to both mechanical and aesthetic aspects of the home. Radiant heated floors on the first floor and finished basement, combined with the A/C upgrade to a non-CFC condenser off of the hydro-air system add to the energy efficiency of this home. Whether there is a power outage in the heat of the summer or the cold of the winter, the 14KW Generac generator will keep everything comfortable. A 6' cedar fence creates a private and safe backyard sanctuary. An easy walk from school, town, or the train and you are home!
